bullets.title: Struggle: The Life and Lost Art of Szukalski
bullets.note: This doc is amazing and bizarre on multiple levels. Here’s the description: “Artists in LA discover the work of forgotten Polish sculptor [Stanisław Szukalski](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanis%C5%82aw_Szukalski), a mad genius whose true story unfolds chapter by astounding chapter.” The documentary was produced by [Leonardo DiCaprio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leonardo_DiCaprio) ([@LeoDiCaprio](https://twitter.com/LeoDiCaprio)) and his father [George DiCaprio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_DiCaprio). You can [find the trailer here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sPkoW4cmqT8). Thanks to Snapping Turtle for the recommendation.
